app.title: YTB Player
app.info_body:
YTB Player • Version {}
Developer: muratgokce

Watch YouTube on the Switch: Shorts, channels, playlists, comments, notifications, resume where you left off, autoplay, subtitles, sponsor skipping and loudness levelling.

Based on Switch-NewPipe by mirusu400. Licensed under the GPLv3; comes with no warranty.

wifi_login.instructions: On a computer or phone on the same Wi-Fi, open a browser and go to:

page.title: YTB Player: sign in
page.heading: Sign in to YouTube on your Switch
page.step1: Install the cookie export extension "Get cookies.txt LOCALLY". It is open source and sends the cookies nowhere.%links%
page.step2: Open a private (incognito) window and sign in to YouTube. In Chrome and Edge, first turn on "Allow in Incognito" in the extension's details.
page.step3: In the same tab, go to `youtube.com/robots.txt`.
page.step4: Click the extension's icon, download `cookies.txt` with "Export", then close the private window. While it stays closed YouTube does not renew these cookies, so the Switch stays signed in for long.
page.step5: Drop the downloaded file below or choose it, then press Send.
page.drop: or drag and drop it here
page.placeholder: Cookies: cookies.txt, a Cookie header or JSON
page.saved: You can go back to your Switch and close this page.
page.empty: Nothing to send: choose cookies.txt or paste the text.
page.privacy: This page comes straight from your Switch, not from the internet; the cookies go only to it.
